title: Governed Action Proposal
description: ADAM-010-A: Canonical data contract representing an evaluated intelligence proposal without granting authorization or execution capability.

proposal_id.description: Unique cryptographic identifier for this proposal.

proposer_identity.description: Identity of the intelligence source generating the proposal.

source_evidence_references.description: Cryptographic digests linking this proposal to prior evaluated evidence.

intent.description: Human-readable description of the proposed outcome.

proposed_operation.description: The constrained category of action being proposed.

risk_evaluation_reference.description: Reference to the Phase 010-B risk/scope classification context.

provenance_digest.description: Cryptographic seal of the proposal payload ensuring immutability.
